criteria.name: JSON shape
criteria.description: Returns the requested fields: answer, window, weather, precip, surface, context, and gates.
criteria.partial_credit: Give 1-2 points for a mostly complete object with one or two missing required fields; give 0 points if the response is not structured enough to grade.

criteria.name: Weather ledger
criteria.description: Computes 46 days, 27 no-rain days, dry share 0.586957, 9 dry-windy days, 8-day run, and 2019-10-06 with 27.5 C, 0.0 mm, 28.4 km/h.
criteria.partial_credit: Give 2-4 points for correct window logic with minor rounding or one missing metric; give 1 point for using the right dates but incorrect threshold counting.

criteria.name: Precipitation counter-check
criteria.description: Reports 67.3 mm Open-Meteo overlap total, 63.502197-75.257064 mm comparison range, and keeps rain_negates_weather_signal false.
criteria.partial_credit: Give 1-2 points for reporting the nonzero rainfall totals but misdescribing how they affect the dry-windy sequence.

criteria.name: Surface-change test
criteria.description: Uses dNBR mean 0.155941, dNBR max 0.9738, alpha-change max 0.493836, and marks the surface gate true.
criteria.partial_credit: Give 2-3 points for correct values with an incomplete threshold comparison; give 1 point for recognizing positive surface change but omitting one required metric.

criteria.name: Context score
criteria.description: Computes population 362810, roads 889, sensitive facilities 102, context score 3, and a passing context gate.
criteria.partial_credit: Give 1-2 points for two correct components or the right score with incomplete component reporting.

criteria.name: Final label and bounded interpretation
criteria.description: Uses gate score 4 and no precipitation override to give strong_compound_fire_weather_surface_context_signal, with no extra realized-loss inference.
criteria.partial_credit: Give 1 point for the right label with weak linkage to the gate score, or for a correct gate score with an imprecise final label.
